text: Method: Enhanced Cross-Attention §3.2, §4.1 The paper describes its connecting layer in three parts ( §3.2 ): linear projections that convert the large model's width (1536) to the small model's (768); an adapter block , an extra non-linear transformation; and a gating mechanism that "dynamically blends the original representations with the external knowledge".
